title: Flow chart
description: Boxes and arrows build one step at a time as you name them (left to right, top to bottom in 9:16). One step can be a decision, drawn as a diamond, with a way forward and a dashed way back to the step before. A dot walks the path: around the loop once, then on to the end, and each box lights up when it arrives. Plain SVG.

props.branch: number of the step that is a decision (counted from 1; optional)
props.label: word on the way forward from the decision (optional)
props.color: colour of the steps (default: one colour per step)
props.color2: colour of the decision and the way back (coral)
props.cues: {"back": time} when the way back draws
props.stage: ground colour: a name from STAGE, any colour, or none
